flashcards.a: Single-qubit ~1e-4, two-qubit ~1e-3 (best: IonQ 99.9923% 2Q fidelity Oct 2025), readout ~1e-2; T1/T2 ~100-300us superconducting vs seconds-minutes for ions.
Success ~ exp(-p2 * d_2Q): depth 100 -> ~90%, depth 1000 -> ~37%. Useful uncorrected circuits: hundreds to ~1000 two-qubit gates; error mitigation buys ~10x back at exponential shot cost.

flashcards.q: Why does classical majority voting fail for qubits?
flashcards.a: No-cloning forbids copying unknown states, and errors are continuous rotations rather than discrete flips. QEC fixes both: non-local encoding + stabiliser measurements digitise errors onto Paulis without revealing amplitudes.

flashcards.q: What does measuring a stabiliser reveal?
flashcards.a: Only parity information (e.g., 'do qubits 1 and 2 agree?'), which locates errors while leaving encoded amplitudes untouched - codewords are +1 eigenvectors, so the data never collapses.
n physical qubits encode k logical with distance d; corrects up to t = floor((d-1)/2) arbitrary single-qubit errors. Shor [[9,1,3]], Steane [[7,1,3]], surface [[d^2,1,d]].

flashcards.q: Surface-code logical error formula and threshold?
flashcards.a: eps_L ~ 0.1 * (100p)^((d+1)/2) per round below threshold p_th ~ 1%. At p=1e-3 targeting 1e-12 needs d~25 => ~1250 physical per logical (~1000:1 overhead).
Below-threshold scaling on 105 qubits: distance 3->5->7 halves logical error each step (Lambda = 2.14); logical qubit lifetime ~5x best physical. NOT demonstrated: scaled logical gates or algorithms.

Bivariate bicycle codes e.g. [[144,12,12]]: 12 logical in 144 physical (~10x lower overhead than surface), but requiring six-way connectivity - driving Nighthawk couplers and L-coupler modular fridges toward Starling 2029.

flashcards.q: Why are magic states counted separately?
flashcards.a: Fault-tolerant T/Toffoli gates consume distilled magic states; factories producing them dominate space-time volume (>50% historically). Clifford gates run cheap/transversally by contrast.

Mitigation (ZNE/PEC): bias reduction at exponential shot cost, practical to ~1e-2-1e-3 on depth <=100 circuits. Correction: exponential reliability growth, viable once p < threshold and overhead affordable. Crossover near >10^4 reliable logical ops.

Syndrome stream arrives every ~1us round; decoder latency must stay under round time with zero backlog (drops silently corrupt logic). FPGA/ASIC union-find/MWPM implementations; hard real-time component.

flashcards.q: Logical error plateaus despite larger d - causes?
flashcards.a: Distance-independent error sources: leakage out of computational space, correlated events (crosstalk/cosmic rays hitting neighbours), measurement-error correlations. Fixes: leakage-reduction units, spacetime decoders, physical spacing.

flashcards.q: How do you vet a 'logical qubit' claim?
flashcards.a: Ask for three numbers: demonstrated Lambda (error suppression factor), decoder latency at that code distance, and magic-state accounting for logical gates. Absence of any = marketing, not engineering.
